provider: LINDAT/CLARIAH-CZ (Charles University, UFAL) — DSpace language-data repository

free_tier.stated: Deposit is free with no published byte ceiling ('It is free and safe'); the only stated object limit is operational. CLARIN-family DSpace instances handle files above 2 GB by special arrangement rather than refusing them. Individual deposited corpora routinely run to tens of GB.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Free. Public items download without login when the licence permits; licence-gated items need an account and an e-signed licence. No metering, no egress pricing. This is a national research-infrastructure node.

tooling: DSpace REST/OAI-PMH plus a documented submission workflow (repository/mydspace); handles as PIDs; SWORD-style deposit contract per collection ('Distribution License Agreement'). CLARIN SPF / eduGAIN SSO, and a local account on request.
chaining: Unlimited items per depositor x no per-item byte cap. Multiple CLARIN centres (LINDAT, CLARIN.SI, CLARIN-D, plus 20+ national nodes) each run their own DSpace with the same open door, so the chain is 'one account per centre'.

limits_note: Account is the gate, not bytes: you need an eduGAIN institutional login, a CLARIN account, or a manually granted local account. Files >2 GB need help-desk handling.
